description: The chart illustrates the GLUE performance of various fine-tuning methods for RoBERTa models of different sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning methods, labeled as Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "GLUE Performance" and has a linear scale ranging from 86 to 88, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Each fine-tuning method is represented by a pair of bars, colored blue and brown, corresponding to the "base" and "large" RoBERTa sizes, respectively, as indicated by the legend. The bars for each method are grouped together, with the blue bar preceding the brown bar. The values of the bars range from approximately 85 to 88.5, with the lowest values observed for the "Prefix", "Adaptor", and "BitFit" methods, and the highest values for the "LoRA" and "S5-model" methods, particularly for the "large" RoBERTa size. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
